title: 5 Proven Ways To Make Money With AI (No Experience)
summary: A side-hustle promoter ranks five AI service and product models (AI UGC ads, AI websites, clipping, voice agents, digital products) with retainer math, admits most AI hustles never earn and that services tie income to hours, and pitches his own tools.

assertions.quote: You can start these today with no experience because every one of them leans on AI to do most of the heavy lifting.

verdicts.note: AI lowers production barriers, but no independent data show typical beginners earning; low barriers mainly increase competition.

Empire/Automators claimed 'AI machine learning' would maximise store revenues for hands-off buyers; the FTC alleges virtually all purchasers failed to earn the advertised income and most lost their entire investment.

In a randomized trial of 640 Kenyan small-business owners given a GPT-4 business mentor, the average effect on revenue and profit was not distinguishable from zero and only above-median performers gained (about 15%), while below-median performers did nearly 10% worse: the tool did not do the hard part for the weakest operators (existing businesses in Kenya over two months, not beginners starting AI side hustles).

assertions.quote: A brand pays you a flat fee every month for a specific batch of videos.

verdicts.note: AI UGC tools have paying brand customers, but many brands avoid synthetic-looking creative and retainers to individuals are unproven at scale.
Some brands buy AI UGC creative, but many avoid synthetic-looking ads and retainers to individuals are unproven at scale.

assertions.quote: You can easily charge a thousand dollars plus as a beginner.

verdicts.note: Small businesses do buy cheap sites, but the same tools let them self-serve and freelance marketplaces already price basic sites low.
Small businesses can build basic sites themselves with the same tools, and beginners without a portfolio struggle to charge designer rates.

assertions.quote: a clipping retainer usually runs anywhere from a thousand to two thousand dollars per month per client

verdicts.note: Clipping agencies exist, but the service is commoditized by the same tools and is often paid per-view rather than on retainer.
Clipping services do sell to creators, but the work is commoditized and often paid per view rather than on retainer.

assertions.quote: once a business implements the agent, getting rid of it impacts the business directly
You build it once and it sells to the next person exactly the same way it sold to the one before.

verdicts.note: Zero marginal cost is real, but distribution is the binding constraint and most self-published digital products sell very few copies.
Zero marginal cost is real, but most digital products sell very few copies and selling them takes ongoing hours of marketing.

assertions.quote: You don't need to be the expert anymore. You just need to know how to point the AI at a problem

verdicts.note: AI can draft content, but marketplaces are flooded with low-value AI books and buyers pay for trust and depth that generic drafts lack.
Marketplaces are flooded with generic AI-written products, and buyers pay for trust and depth that expertise provides.

assertions.quote: when everyone can do the same thing, people start competing on price. And normally, that's a race to the bottom
The money exists because you keep showing up. You are chained to your work.

verdicts.note: Definitional for services; income stops when delivery stops unless a team is hired.

assertions.quote: I don't believe in passive income, I think that term's BS. I don't think there's such thing as passive income
It's kind of like a slot machine with unlimited plays. You will eventually hit, but it might take several attempts

verdicts.note: Repeated attempts raise the odds but nothing guarantees a hit; most sellers quit or exhaust funds before one lands.
Repeated attempts raise the odds but guarantee nothing, and most sellers quit or run out of money before a hit.

assertions.quote: There are a ton AI side hustles out there that sound incredible in theory, but most never make a dollar.

verdicts.note: Consistent with survey data on side-hustle earnings, though stated without evidence by a promoter of the remaining five.
